verdict.rationale: Gumloop agents can be given natural-language instructions and goals, chatted with via sessions/chat completions, updated via natural language ('Update your instructions so you always do it this way'), and reached via Slack/Teams/email using plain conversational messages — this covers a good chunk of natural-language operation. However, core setup (creating agents, connecting connectors, configuring triggers, skills) appears to be done through a builder UI/API rather than purely via natural-language commands, so the product is not fully natural-language-native end-to-end. missing for 10: evidence that agent creation/configuration itself (not just runtime interaction) can be done via natural language, and independent/hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs.
